style: chunky stylised Norse ruin, low-poly angular stone with painted soft colour, mossy, weathered timber, hand-painted look, same family as the well (assets-src/model-loop/well_test)

stone_cut.prompt: pale blue-grey cut granite with painted blotches, slightly warmer on edges

moss.prompt: bright saturated green moss, painterly blotches, darker green hollows

timber_old.prompt: weathered grey-brown timber, lengthwise grain, bleached and cracked

notes.concept: input.png = the ruined Norse temple on dry ground; input_water.png = the same scene flooded, only to visualise: the temple is placed in water by hand in the game, so no water, base tile or sand is modelled
notes.scope: user 2026-10-31: model-loop for all SMALL elements only (leaf parts). Groups (colonnade, arch, stairs, roof, gable, walls, boulders) and the root come after the parts are accepted.
notes.library: reuse where it fits: well kit (assets-src/model-loop/well_test/kit/part_stone.blend stone_a/b/c squarer ashlar-like, d-i loaves; part_timber.blend timber_a-f beams), village kit (assets-src/village: temple_build.py dragon() / house_build.py HEAD_DRAGON profile, textures/carve.png knotwork, rune.png, beam.png, village_models.blend). Game rocks (public/models rock-medium, stone-pack) are scanned, not this style, not used.
